name: aida_r5_lab_vial_close
purpose: the user's task (2026-10-17), the vial closed again: the cap set on the neck at the thread's start, the R5's left hand screws it on in strokes until it seats - the torque it closes it with is what holds it next time (behaviors.cap_thread); pill_bottle rung 4's closing

grasp_plan.why: a tripod low on the cap's skirt, turned clockwise (seen from above) about the vial's axis 80 deg a stroke - the whole thread and 20 deg more, the last of it into the seat, where the closing torque the hand holds is the closure's new application torque - then let go and the hand withdrawn

grasp_replay.why: the planned cap turn, closing (plan_er_grasp.py, task cap_turn, turn_deg < 0)
grasp_replay.controller_why: HomeHero's recordings and planner paths are commands to its R5 action layer (gravity-compensated arm targets, gravity feed-forward elsewhere); plain targets leave the shoulder slide 7.5 mm under its target (7.6 kg on 10 kN/m)

hand_model.why: the halt (word 007) set above the force band, 8.0 V, so the position loop governs the squeeze: at the 3.0 V default the index stalls at about 3 N, the band's floor, and could tighten no further. Driven by the grip command alone this pinch failed every way: at 3.0 V the thumb flicked the 14 g pawn out before it stalled; at 1.0 V with 0.8 V post-contact the digits crept closed during the carry and rolled it out at 61 deg; at 1.0 V with 0 V the stored 2.4 N drained in half a second of lift

grip.why: a twisting grip: the closure's hold of 0.15 N m at the cap's 22 mm radius is 6.8 N round its rim; the strokes broke it loose with the digits at 3-4 N. The floor at 2 N: in a tripod the thumb opposes index and middle at an angle and reads below them (2.5-2.9 N against 3.2-4.1) - with a 3 N floor the band never read 'loaded' and the lift that takes the freed cap away aborted (2026-10-18); under the fingertip's ~8 N stall

cap.why: the cap set loose on the neck at the thread's start (as a hand sets it there before turning it), caught by the thread's law and screwed on; the 0.3 N m is only the law's starting record - the take's own closing torque replaces it at the seat
